JOYSTAR Little Violet Girls' Bike - Sizes 12" to 16"
Let her pedal into a world of magic with the JOYSTAR Little Violet Girls' Bike. This charming ride combines a sweet vintage silhouette with modern engineering, designed specifically for little riders aged 2-7 to explore the world with confidence and style.

Classic charm for modern adventures: The JOYSTAR Little Violet in Vibrant Purple.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Built with a focus on stability and ease of use, the Little Violet provides a secure foundation for every child's first cycling milestones."
Robust Safety Features
Safety is at the heart of the Little Violet. It features a sturdy HI-TEN steel frame designed to withstand the learning process. The dual-braking system includes a front caliper hand brake and a rear coaster brake, allowing beginners to stop intuitively with their feet while learning to use hand controls.

Total control through reliable braking and durable construction.

Key Features & Benefits

Adjustable Fit: Quick-release seat post and adjustable handlebars allow the bike to grow with your child.

Safety First: Fully enclosed chain guard protects little fingers and keeps clothes clean.

Smooth Ride: 2.125" wide pneumatic rubber tires offer excellent grip and stability on various surfaces.

Delightful Accessories: Features shimmering handlebar streamers, a woven front basket, and a classic bike bell.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get riding sooner with JOYSTAR's streamlined setup. The Little Violet arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and clear instructions, you can have the bike ready for the sidewalk in about 20 minutes.

Assembly Guide: Quick and simple setup for the JOYSTAR Little Violet.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

Explore Every Detail
Get a close-up look at the craftsmanship and safety features of the JOYSTAR Little Violet. This video highlights the reinforced frame, precision braking system, and the premium finish that sets our bikes apart.

Detailed Walkthrough: A closer look at the Little Violet's engineering and design.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR stands behind the quality of our bikes with a comprehensive warranty program:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Steel frames are covered against defects for as long as the original owner keeps the bike.

2-Year Component Coverage: Major non-wear parts are protected for 24 months.
